messages:
maria: FYI I'm opening a small PR to clarify how quota tiers + burst credits show up in the Usage Analytics dashboard and the rate limit docs. Found a few confusing sentences and one broken dashboard link.

maria: Goal: add a short runbook example for customers who see 'burst credits consumed' along with a sample SDK header + a screenshot of the panel. Also rename panel from "Effective rate" -> "Applied throughput" per product ask.

maria: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4128 (WIP) -- leaving notes in the diff. @kevin can you confirm the wording around burst expiry window?

kevin: Yep saw the PR, will review. Short answer: burst credits expire in a rolling 1h window; wording should be "rolling 60m consumption window" not "per-hour reset" — that caused confusion in support.

alex: Quick nit: in meter docs we should show the actual header name we expose. Suggest adding example: 

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "X-Redwood-Quota: tier=pro;burst=300" \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

alex: And a JS snippet for SDK users: 

```js
client.request({
  model: 'rwd-7b',
  headers: { 'X-Redwood-Quota': 'tier=pro;burst=300' }
})
```

maria: perfect. I'll paste those in the examples section. Also adding a short migration note for Dedicated customers about panel name change and an alert query update.

sam: For dashboard rename, product wants a short changelog blurb and a linkable alias — can we keep the old panel slug usable for 30 days and map it? Ops will do a redirect but docs should mention it.

maria: Good call. I'll add: "Old panel slug `/d/abc123/effective-rate` will redirect to `/d/abc123/applied-throughput` for 30 days." Short snippet in docs + note in release notes.

kevin: Also add a small table showing calculation for "applied throughput":

- configured_rate = tokens_per_minute from customer config
- burst_bonus = min(burst_credits_left, cap)
- applied_throughput = configured_rate + burst_bonus / 60

kevin: Keep it text, not a formula image.

maria: Will do. One more: found one dashboard link in the metering overview that pointed to staging. Replacing with the canonical panel URL.

docs-bot: PR #4128 opened by maria in docs. Labels: docs, metering, urgent. Requested reviewers: alex, kevin.

alex: Reviewing now. Quick suggestion: under 'rate limits' section, emphasise that quota headers are advisory for hosted routing and do not override Dedicated isolation rules. Short sentence + link to Dedicated docs.

maria: adding that. Also adding a tiny QA checklist at the top of the PR description:

- [ ] confirm burst wording w/ billing (kevin)
- [ ] update SDK examples (alex)
- [ ] fix dashboard links (maria)
- [ ] add redirect note + release blurb (sam)

maria: tagging for review — if you can both glance before EOD I'd appreciate it. If anything controversial I'll split into 2 PRs. :thumbsup:

kevin: Approving wording change for burst window. One last tiny thing: change "credits consumed" -> "burst credits consumed" in the panel legend.

alex: Left two inline comments about code formatting and an extra trailing backtick. Otherwise LGTM.

sam: I'll schedule the release note for Friday. If we keep the redirect for 30 days we'll coordinate with ops.

maria: thanks all — merging after fixes. Will post a short follow-up in #product once release note is live.
